rationale: The discourse has clarified the economics and each side’s constraints, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor and state reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, family, and investors still require real footprint reduction and durable cost cuts. Rounds 1 and 2 show hardened positions with only limited movement toward conditional, untested compromise, so further unstructured repetition is likely to circle without resolving the impasse.
